description: Use this when the user asks for a hint on today's DeducePuzzles board. Names one clue to re-read, by number only. Does not reveal a person, a seat, a floor, or a rank. Do not use for a solution or a walkthrough. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person.

attemptId.description: Conversation id returned by get_daily_puzzle. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person. Pass this same id on every later call in the conversation.

playerToken.description: Anonymous token returned by an earlier get_daily_puzzle. Pass it back to keep this app's streak. Omit it to start a new one. Not an account, and not a website streak. 16–64 letters, digits, _ or -.

name: get_hint
title: Clue-number hint
